services.desc: Our Lake Blue Ridge tours are great for fishing charters, family trips, relaxing sunset cruises, wedding parties or any special event. During the charter, you can enjoy fishing, swimming, relaxing, drinking or any combination. The choice is yours. All tours include cooler with ice, pick up from a public boat launch or private dock, sound system on board allowing you to be the DJ of your charter and life jackets for everyone on board.
